pages.title: Here Is Our Address
pages.text: Create your own settlement through its normal interface.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Open the native settlement controls and choose creation. Confirm the displayed bounds and price. Use its normal map tools for expansion; the quest does not pay territorial costs for you.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Found a town around your own bell with price, boundary and ownership checks.
